psychological_meaning: Dark Fern evokes feelings of tranquility, growth, and stability. It is associated with nature, particularly forests and lush vegetation, suggesting a sense of grounding and connection to the earth. This color promotes a sense of calmness and can inspire feelings of well-being and renewal.
